items.exampleEn: Being a housewife can be as busy as an office job.

items.exampleEn: The festival builds goodwill between the two towns.
items.exampleZh: 這個節慶增進了兩個小鎮之間的友好情誼。

items.exampleEn: Volunteer helpers at the race handed water to the runners.
items.exampleZh: 比賽中的志工幫手把水遞給跑者。

items.exampleEn: Her stepfather taught her how to drive.
Nurses need to be caring as well as skilled.
items.exampleZh: 護理師不但要技術好，也要有愛心。

items.exampleEn: They wed on a beach in front of fifty guests.
items.exampleZh: 他們在海灘上、在五十位賓客面前結婚。

items.exampleEn: This dearly loved cartoon has been on TV for thirty years.
items.exampleZh: 這部深受喜愛的卡通已經在電視上播了三十年。
items.glossZh: 深深地；付出高昂代價地

items.exampleEn: She had a strict upbringing in a small town.
items.exampleZh: 她在小鎮受到嚴格的教養長大。

items.sentenceEn: We need more helpers to set up the chairs before the party.
items.sentenceZh: 派對前我們需要更多幫手來擺椅子。

items.audioEn: My stepfather and I go fishing together every summer.
items.audioZh: 我和繼父每年夏天都一起去釣魚。
items.questionZh: 說話者每年夏天和繼父做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Our neighbors are caring people who always help each other.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的鄰居都是很有愛心的人，總是互相幫忙。

items.sentenceEn: The company paid dearly for its mistake.
items.sentenceZh: 這家公司為自己的錯誤付出了慘痛的代價。

items.stemEn: After the argument, the two brothers shook hands to show their ____.
items.stemZh: 吵架之後，兩兄弟握手，表達彼此的善意。

items.stemEn: She plans to ____ her college boyfriend this autumn.
items.stemZh: 她打算今年秋天和大學時的男朋友結婚。

items.passageEn: My friend Leo's family is a little unusual. His mother, a former housewife, now runs a successful bakery. When Leo was six, she wed a kind man who became his stepfather. At first, Leo was not sure about him, but his stepfather's genuine goodwill won him over. Every weekend, Leo was his stepfather's little helper in the garage, fixing bikes and old radios. Leo says this caring upbringing taught him patience. He still loves his stepfather dearly, and he calls him Dad.
items.passageZh: 我朋友 Leo 的家庭有點不一樣。他媽媽以前是家庭主婦，現在經營一家生意很好的麵包店。Leo 六歲時，她嫁給一位很和善的男人，那人成了 Leo 的繼父。一開始 Leo 對他有些猶豫，但繼父真誠的善意打動了他。每個週末，Leo 都在車庫當繼父的小幫手，一起修腳踏車和舊收音機。Leo 說，這種充滿關愛的成長環境教會了他耐心。他至今仍深愛他的繼父，也叫他爸爸。

questions.questionZh: Leo 的媽媽現在做什麼？
Leo 說這樣的成長環境教會他什麼？

items.promptZh: 她的教養讓她懂得尊重別人。
referenceEn: Her upbringing taught her to respect other people.
Thanks to her upbringing, she knows how to respect others.
rubricZh: upbringing 指「教養、成長過程」（例如 her upbringing）
「尊重別人」可寫 respect others、respect other people 等

items.promptZh: 我的主管很體貼，總是記得我們每個人的生日。
referenceEn: My manager is very caring and always remembers everyone's birthday.
My boss is a caring person who always remembers our birthdays.
rubricZh: caring 是形容詞，表示「體貼的、有愛心的」（例如 is very caring、a caring person 等）
「記得每個人的生日」可寫，例如 remembers everyone's birthday、remembers our birthdays 等
always 位置不扣分；主詞代名詞用 he 或 she 都可以
